title: These Robotic Arms Are Powered by Algae. Watch How They Move

claims.claim: Delft University of Technology'deki bir araştırma ekibi, yüzeyi alglerle kolonize edilmiş yumuşak bir robotik kol geliştirmiştir.

evidence.quote: now a research team at Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands has developed a soft robotic arm colonized by algae on its surface
now a research team at Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands has developed a soft robotic arm colonized by algae on its surface, and when the microbes photosynthesize, the arm moves.
“We didn’t start with a specific application. Our goal has always been to bring the research of living materials to new levels,” Marie-Eve Aubin-Tam, who led the research

“We didn’t start with a specific application. Our goal has always been to bring the research of living materials to new levels,” Marie-Eve Aubin-Tam, who led the research, explained in a press release.

claims.claim: Küçük robot kolları yaklaşık üçte dört inç uzunluğunda ve bir kredi kartı kalınlığındadır.

evidence.quote: The tiny robot arms—about three-quarters of an inch long and about as thick as a credit card
The tiny robot arms—about three-quarters of an inch long and about as thick as a credit card—are constructed of two layers of hydrogel that the algal cells live on.

claims.claim: Robot kolları alglerin yaşadığı iki katmanlı hidrojelden inşa edilmiştir.

evidence.quote: are constructed of two layers of hydrogel that the algal cells live on.
The tiny robot arms—about three-quarters of an inch long and about as thick as a credit card—are constructed of two layers of hydrogel that the algal cells live on.

claims.claim: Asidik koşullarda, pH 3 ile 7 arasında, katman orijinal ağırlığının yaklaşık yüzde 37'si kadardı, ancak pH 11'de orijinal ağırlığının dört katına çıktı.

evidence.quote: In acidic conditions, such as between pH 3 and 7, the layer was approximately 37 percent of its original weight, but it had quadruple its original weight at pH 11.

claims.claim: Kimyasal değişim, ışık uygulandıktan yaklaşık 20 saniye ve karanlık olduktan yaklaşık 10 saniye sonra hızlı bir şekilde başlar, ancak hidrojelin belirgin şekilde bükülmesi birkaç saat sürer.

evidence.quote: The chemical shift begins quickly, about 20 seconds after light is applied and about 10 seconds after it becomes dark, but it takes several hours for the hydrogel to bend significantly.

claims.claim: Araştırma ekibi, ışığa maruz kaldığında kapanan dört parmaklı bir tutucu da dahil olmak üzere birkaç algal cihaz inşa etti.

evidence.quote: After their first proof of concept, the research team constructed several more algal devices. One was a four-fingered gripper that closes when exposed to light.

claims.claim: Bu hikaye orijinal olarak WIRED Japan'da yayınlanmıştır ve Japoncadan çevrilmiştir.

evidence.quote: This story originally appeared on WIRED Japan and has been translated from Japanese.
